messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Equinox (customer_id: equinox-prod) in eu-west-1 dedicated pool 'eq-dedicated-eu1' exceeding p99 latency SLO. Current p99=2.8s (SLO=1.2s). Error rate normal. Auto pages sent to oncall.

oncall-marc: got the page, ack. spiking since 07:12 UTC. Paging SRE and runtime teams. Opening war room thread.

sre-alyssa: looking at metrics -> tail latency jump at 07:10, correlates with cache miss rate increase on pool eq-dedicated-eu1. Any deployments? @eng-runtime-wei

eng-runtime-wei: no deployments in eu-west-1 in last 30m. Checking routing and model variants.

support-lina: Customer CS emailed: "we're seeing slow responses in production" — they reported p95 ~1.6s earlier, now worse. I'll prepare customer-facing note.

oncall-marc: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle noisy tenant if needed 2) route new requests to warm spare pool 3) increase dedicated pool capacity (if available) 4) enable KV prefix cache bypass fallback. @ops-bot please attempt scale-up.

ops-bot: Scaling request submitted: increase eq-dedicated-eu1 by +2 GPUs (requested at 07:14 UTC). ETA ~3m. Will report back.

sre-alyssa: quick isolation probe: obs shows a high ratio of long-context requests from tenant 'equinox-search' — they are heavy reranking jobs. Suggest temporarily move that tenant to burst pool or apply rate-limit.

eng-runtime-wei: can do tenant re-route via routing policy change. Command:
```
redwoodctl route update --tenant equinox-search --pool eq-burst-eu1 --priority=10
```
Do we want immediate move?

oncall-marc: Yes, move the tenant and monitor p99. Apply a conservative max concurrency 8 for that tenant after move.

support-lina: Sending short update to account team and CS: "We've detected elevated latency and are routing heavy rerank traffic off your primary pool while we stabilize. No data loss; response degradation possible for in-flight requests." :phone:

ops-bot: Scale completed at 07:17 UTC (+2 GPUs). Noted some improvement but p99 still ~1.6s.

sre-alyssa: after routing equinox-search to burst pool (07:18 UTC) p99 dropped to 1.1s for the primary pool. Monitoring for 10m to ensure stability.

customer-success-jordan: Confirmed customer sees improvements on their side. They're asking for ETA on full mitigation and RCA.

oncall-marc: Good. Keep war room for 30m. Action items: 1) eng-runtime to create post-incident ticket with root cause analysis 2) SRE to run traffic replay to reproduce 3) CS to coordinate customer update and timeline. I’ll handoff to SRE lead in 15m.

eng-runtime-wei: Filing issue: RED-INC-2026-4924. Will include routing logs, tenant query shapes, and hot KV miss analysis.

sre-alyssa: leaving note: continuing to monitor for tail risk. If p99 creeps above 1.3s again, revert routing and initiate full rollback to compatible model (lower mem footprint). :eyes:

oncall-marc: handing off incident to SRE lead @sre-alyssa for post-mitigation tracking. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: p99 back within SLO on eq-dedicated-eu1 (p99=1.05s). War room closed at 07:22 UTC. Follow-up ticket: RED-INC-2026-4924.
